method.baseline: no change: the close on the forecast day
method.scored_on: the last close on or before forecast day + horizon

metrics.mape: mean absolute error, % of the actual price
metrics.win_rate: % of forecasts closer to the actual price than 'no change'
metrics.direction_hit_rate: % of forecasts that got the direction of the move right
metrics.band_coverage: % of actual prices inside the forecast's 80% band
